crossrefs.text: He who walks with the wise will become wise, but the companion of fools will be destroyed.
I will guide you in the way of wisdom; I will lead you on straight paths.
She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the heights of the city,
And I tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build My church, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.
Do not work for food that perishes, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For on Him God the Father has placed His seal of approval.”
He built the House of the Forest of Lebanon a hundred cubits long, fifty cubits wide, and thirty cubits high, with four rows of cedar pillars supporting the cedar beams.
The house was roofed with cedar above the beams that rested on the pillars—forty-five beams, fifteen per row.
He who commits adultery lacks judgment; whoever does so destroys himself.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding. His praise endures forever!
And He said to man, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom, and to turn away from evil is understanding.’”
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline.
When all has been heard, the conclusion of the matter is this: Fear God and keep His commandments, because this is the whole duty of man.
then you will discern the fear of the LORD and discover the knowledge of God.
The fear of the LORD prolongs life, but the years of the wicked will be cut short.
Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.
Let the righteous man strike me; let his rebuke be an act of loving devotion. It is oil for my head; let me not refuse it. For my prayer is ever against the deeds of the wicked.
She is loud and defiant; her feet do not remain at home.
Food gained by fraud is sweet to a man, but later his mouth is full of gravel.
Her house is the road to Sheol, descending to the chambers of death.
Do not gaze at wine while it is red, when it sparkles in the cup and goes down smoothly.
In the end it bites like a snake and stings like a viper.

When the woman saw that the tree was good for food and pleasing to the eyes, and that it was desirable for obtaining wisdom, she took the fruit and ate it. She also gave some to her husband who was with her, and he ate it.

When Gehazi came to the hill, he took the gifts from the servants and stored them in the house. Then he dismissed the men, and they departed. When Gehazi went in and stood before his master, Elisha asked him, “Gehazi, where have you been?” “Your servant did not go anywhere,” he replied. But Elisha questioned him, “Did not my spirit go with you when the man got down from his chariot to meet you? Is this the time to accept money and clothing, olive groves and vineyards, sheep and oxen, menservants and maidservants? Therefore, the leprosy of Naaman will cling to you and your descendants forever!” And as Gehazi left his presence, he was leprous—as white as snow.
They do not know or understand; they wander in the darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.
